preconditions.description: The dimensions of the board must be within the range of 1 to 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in board)
preconditions.description: Each row of the board must have exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'wb.' for row in board for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each character in the board must be either 'w', 'b', or '.'.

postconditions.description: The output must start with either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES') and all(len(row) == m for row in tiling)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the tiling must consist of n rows, each with m characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES') and all(c in 'abcd.' for row in tiling for c in row)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the tiling must only contain the characters 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', or '.'.
